confidence_notes: I checked food and drink prices with web searches. Restaurant and beer anchors come from aggregated cost-of-living figures. Numbeo's Oct 2026 Sarande data gave about 800 ALL for an inexpensive meal, 4,500 ALL for a three-course meal for two, and 290 ALL for a domestic draft pint. Other 2026 guides put beer at about 200-400 ALL. I converted lek to USD at roughly 85 ALL per USD, which is my own approximation. I raised prices slightly for July peak season in this coastal resort, where promenade venues charge more. Cappuccino results were inconsistent: about 100-150 ALL in older local figures and $2-3 in recent guides. Cocktail (about 700-1,000 ALL) and wine-by-the-glass (about 300-600 ALL) figures come from 2026 nightlife and restaurant guides, not an index, so they are less certain. Accommodation anchors were not searched. They are model estimates from general knowledge of Saranda's July high season, when prices are well above shoulder-season levels, and are the least certain anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: Restaurant and drink anchors are based on aggregated Saranda price data, adjusted for summer tourist demand. Accommodation is judged against other Albanian Riviera and Balkan coastal resorts in peak season, such as Ksamil, Himara and Durres. These are cheaper than Croatian or Montenegrin coastal towns but well above inland Albania.
